title: Fake Merc Character Study (part. 13): Bigger than Serge
summary: Part 13 of NH's mocking series about YouTuber Jason Blaha. He says he has messaged Blaha through catfish and fake client accounts, claims Blaha has almost no coaching clients and gives teenagers poor diet advice, and goes through Blaha's feuds with and size comparisons to Athlean-X, Serge Nubret, Rich Piana, Jeff Seid and the Hodgetwins. Most of it is personal insult; the claims below are NH's allegations, not verified facts, and the few training points are incidental.
claims: NH says he created more than 26 fake accounts and catfish profiles to contact Blaha and request coaching, and never got a reply

NH alleges Blaha advised teenage clients to swap vegetables for orange juice, add butter and oil to every meal and drink a gallon of milk a day, and that one 16-year-old client got acne and fat within a month
NH alleges Blaha sent every client the same badly formatted spreadsheet program
Hating Athlean-X doesn't make Blaha right; a broken clock is right twice a day
Size comparisons mean nothing at high body fat; claims of being bigger than pros like Serge Nubret, Rich Piana or the Hodgetwins ignore height, leanness and the obvious
If it jiggles when you shake it, it's fat, not muscle
A fat chest is not being gifted in the chest
Big calves on someone obese for years come from carrying bodyweight, not genetic gift, and calves matter little to how a physique looks
NH says Blaha once wrote for Tiger Fitness selling supplements, despite now calling supplements a scam
Overweight lifters hurt their shoulders doing pull-ups
